fusions.name: Whirling Nick
fusions.desc: A spinning chop that costs 4% of your maximum health and deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, making them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Skyfall Cleave
fusions.desc: You leap up to 8 tiles onto the target and deal 30 damage, plus 6% of its maximum health if it is a boss or elite. It is left 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Raised Edge
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 10 seconds, and you move 20% faster for the first 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gap in the Guard
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 12% of the target's armour. You have 6% more dodge chance.
